gloss: to fascinate; to captivate; to enchant

definitions.gloss: to fascinate; to captivate; to enchant
definitions.explanation: To charm or captivate an audience through an impressive performance, beauty, or skill. Written with {魅|み} (charm/bewitch) to distinguish it from the ordinary {見|み}せる (to show).

examples.japanese: ⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{魅|み}せた。
⟦{圧倒的|あっとうてき}→圧倒的：05853_attouteki⟧な⟦{演技|えんぎ}→演技：01890_engi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{人|ひと}々⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{魅|み}せる⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧だ。
examples.english: He's an actor who captivates people with overwhelming performances.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦ダンサー→ダンサー：08801_dansaa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{独自|どくじ}→独自：05614_dokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スタイル→スタイル：03851_sutairu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{魅|み}せ、⟦{一躍|いちやく}→一躍：11183_ichiyaku⟧⟦スター→スター：00393_sutaa⟧になった。
examples.english: The dancer captivated people around the world with a unique style and became a star overnight.

notes:
An ichidan verb using the kanji {魅|み} (enchant/charm) instead of the standard ⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧ of ⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧ (to show). This spelling emphasizes the captivating or spellbinding quality of what is being shown.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{魅|み}せる (captivate the audience)
- ⟦{演技|えんぎ}→演技：01890_engi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{魅|み}せる (enchant with a performance)
- {魅|み}せる⟦プレー→プレー：29432_puree⟧ (a dazzling play/performance)

USAGE:
Often appears in entertainment, sports, and arts contexts. The passive form {魅|み}せられる (to be captivated) is also common. Related to ⟦{魅了|みりょう}する→魅了する：19016_miryousuru⟧ (to fascinate) and ⟦{魅力|みりょく}→魅力：03749_miryoku⟧ (charm/appeal), all sharing the kanji {魅|み}. In casual writing, sometimes used interchangeably with ⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧ to add dramatic flair, but the distinction is meaningful in careful writing.
